name: Reviewer Rejected (insufficient) → Researcher Retry
description: ADR-041 Slice 2D-3 recovery rule. Fires when reviewer-research OR reviewer-spec terminates with decide(action=insufficient) AND recoverycounter has stamped chain.recovery.proceed="true" on the reviewer loop entity (within ADR-040 chain-level cap, default 3 cycles). Replaces the legacy research-mode-transition/02-reviewer-rejected-spawn-curator.json (deleted in Slice 2D-1 since curator was dismantled by the MVP roster) plus dev-via-spec/02-reviewer-rejected-retry-planner.json. Spawns researcher-plan with the reviewer's reason; the new researcher re-enters the chain at plan and re-runs through gather/synthesize/architect addressing the gap. Two-step fire shape: reviewer's insufficient terminal lands, recoverycounter wakes on agent.complete and writes the proceed sentinel if within budget, this rule's third condition then passes and the rule fires.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.researcher-plan
on_enter.prompt:
The reviewer (mode: $entity.triple.agent.loop.role) at loop $entity.instance rejected the prior research arc with decide(action=insufficient). chain.recovery.proceed gate is satisfied (within chain-level recovery cap, ADR-040).

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result on $entity.instance to read the reviewer's structured terminal (decision_reason naming the gaps). Then call read_loop_result on the prior researcher's loop ($entity.triple.lineage.researcher) if available, to read the prior research artifact verbatim. Your job is to RE-PLAN the research arc with the reviewer's gaps addressed, not start from scratch.

Iteration 2+ — emit a revised plan per researcher-plan/10-plan-rules.md. Carry forward what's correct; tighten scope or extend epics only where the reviewer's reason demands. Terminal: decide(action="gather") to forward into the gather phase per researcher-plan/00-identity.md. The recovery property + reviewer_loop_id are stamped on this loop for downstream phases to thread back through if needed.

metadata.two_step_fire: Condition #3 chain.recovery.proceed="true" reads from the triggering reviewer entity's local triples. recoverycounter.Counter (cmd/semteams/recoverycounter/counter.go) wakes on the same agent.complete event, does the chain ancestry walk, and writes the proceed sentinel only when newCount ≤ threshold. First evaluation (before counter wakes) fails the third condition; counter write fires the entity_watcher again; rule re-evaluates and fires. Mirrors recoverycounter/doc.go §'The two-step rule fire'.
metadata.fail_safe: Counter hiccup (graph read failure, NATS blip) leaves proceed unstamped; rule never fires; chain stalls fail-safe at the most recent insufficient verdict. Audit triple chain.recovery.count lands best-effort on the chain entity even when proceed write fails.
metadata.max_iterations_note: Per-entity rule-state caveat — each reviewer loop is a new entity, so this budget is informational under the current rule engine. Real bound: chain-level chain.recovery cap via recoverycounter (default 3 cycles, configurable via NewCounter).
